kessraSeaWall.title: Sea wall at Kessra
kessraSeaWall.request: Our lower town floods on every spring tide. Build us a wall the sea cannot push over. We can pay in trust and in what grows on our shore.
kessraSeaWall.conditions: Hot sun, strong tide, salt spray.

velTorHomes.title: Warm homes at Vel Tor
velTorHomes.request: The dark season is long and the wind cuts. Grow us walls that hold warmth.
